annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and (EU) 2018/1139 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and (EU) 2018/1139 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (Digital Omnibus on AI) amending the EU AI Act and the Civil Aviation Regulation 2018/1139. It delays high-risk obligations until standards are available (latest Dec 2027 for Annex III and Aug 2028 for Annex I products), extends SME relief to small mid-caps, centralises oversight in the AI Office, and expands sandboxes and real-world testing, including for product-embedded AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Links the application of high-risk rules to the availability of standards, with long-stop dates of 2 Dec 2027 (Annex III) and 2 Aug 2028 (Annex I).
Extends SME privileges on documentation, quality management and penalties to small mid-caps.
Gives the AI Office exclusive supervision of AI systems built on GPAI models by the same provider and of AI in very large online platforms and search engines, excluding Annex I products.
Extends real-world testing to AI in Annex I products, with a new Article 60a voluntary testing agreement for Section B products, and creates an EU-level sandbox.
Turns the AI literacy obligation into a duty on the Commission and Member States, and adds a legal basis for processing special-category data for bias detection.
